air_of_a_comeback.text_zh: 你可以将你坟场中的一张非攻击行动牌置于你的牌库顶。若你手牌中没有牌，改为将其置入你的手牌。
air_of_a_comeback.text_en: You may put a non-attack action card from your graveyard on top of your deck. If you have no cards in hand, instead you may play it this turn from your graveyard without paying its {r} cost.

alluring_inducement.text_zh:
希亚娜专精
当此牌攻击时，防御英雄展示其手牌。你可以选择一张以此方式展示的攻击行动牌。若如此做，此牌成为所选牌。
团结——当此牌与一张来自手牌的牌一起防御时，在任意数量英雄的控制下创造一个雄辩衍生物。
alluring_inducement.text_en:
Shiyana Specialization
When this attacks, the defending hero reveals their hand. You may choose an attack action card revealed this way. If you do, this becomes the chosen card.
Unity - When this defends together with a card from hand, create an Eloquence token under any number of heroes' control.

arena_medic.text_zh:
获得1点生命。
若你手牌中没有牌，改为获得3点生命。
arena_medic.text_en:
Gain 1{h}.
If you have no cards in hand, instead gain 3{h}.

benefactor_of_bloodworth_goldmane.text_zh:
创造一个金币衍生物。
你本回合的下一次攻击获得“当此牌攻击时，它获得+X力量，X为你控制的金币数量。”
benefactor_of_bloodworth_goldmane.text_en:
Create a Gold token.
Your next attack this turn gets "When this attacks, it gets +X{p}, where X is the number of Gold you control."

big_hits_big_applause.text_zh:
直到回合结束，每当一位英雄赢得交锋时，该英雄抽一张牌。
与每位对手英雄交锋。
big_hits_big_applause.text_en:
Until end of turn, whenever a hero wins a clash, they draw a card.
Clash with each opposing hero.

brush_of_heavenly_rites.text_zh: 每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：从你的物品栏装备一件名称中含有宣言的副手。再动
brush_of_heavenly_rites.text_en: Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Equip an off-hand with Proclamation in its name from your inventory. Go again

code_of_conduct_kill_or_be_killed.name_en: Code of Conduct: Kill or Be Killed
code_of_conduct_kill_or_be_killed.text_zh: 直到回合结束，你可以攻击任意对手英雄，且当你对其造成致命伤害时，在此回合之后额外进行一个回合。
code_of_conduct_kill_or_be_killed.text_en: Until end of turn, you may attack any opposing hero and when you deal lethal damage to them, take an extra turn after this one.

crowd_roars_fight.text_zh: 你本回合的下一次攻击获得+1力量，且可以攻击任意对手英雄。
crowd_roars_fight.text_en: Your next attack this turn gets +1{p} and may attack any opposing hero.

crushing_impact.text_zh: 本回合你下一次将造成少于4点伤害时，改为造成4点伤害。
crushing_impact.text_en: The next time you would deal less than 4 damage this turn, instead deal 4 damage.

didnt_see_that_coming.text_zh: 每位生命高于你的英雄弃一张牌。
didnt_see_that_coming.text_en: Each hero who has more {h} than you discards a card.

dominate_the_competition.text_zh: 你本回合的下一次攻击获得支配。
dominate_the_competition.text_en: Your next attack this turn gets dominate.

dragons_of_legend.text_zh:
德拉科娜·奥普提迈 - 1资源, 6费用, 3防御
托梅尔泰 - 1资源, 5费用, 3防御
多米尼亚 - 1资源, 4费用, 3防御
阿兹沃莱 - 1资源, 0费用, 3防御
克罗迈 - 1资源, 0费用, 3防御
凯洛里亚 - 1资源, 1费用, 3防御
米拉盖 - 1资源, 1费用, 3防御
内克里亚 - 1资源, 3费用, 3防御
欧维亚 - 1资源, 2费用, 3防御
泰迈 - 1资源, 2费用, 3防御
文塞拉凯 - 1资源, 3费用, 3防御
延杜莱 - 1资源, 1费用, 3防御
你可以将此牌放入你的牌库以替代你拥有的一张召龙。勾选此牌所召唤龙名旁边的方框。当此牌被使用或置入你的坟场时，将其替换为被召龙的牌。
dragons_of_legend.text_en:
Dracona Optimai - 1 pitch, 6 cost, 3 block
Tomeltai - 1 pitch, 5 cost, 3 block
Dominia - 1 pitch, 4 cost, 3 block
Azvolai - 1 pitch, 0 cost, 3 block
Cromai - 1 pitch, 0 cost, 3 block
Kyloria - 1 pitch, 1 cost, 3 block
Miragai - 1 pitch, 1 cost, 3 block
Nekria - 1 pitch, 3 cost, 3 block
Ouvia - 1 pitch, 2 cost, 3 block
Themai - 1 pitch, 2 cost, 3 block
Vynserakai - 1 pitch, 3 cost, 3 block
Yendurai - 1 pitch, 1 cost, 3 block
You may put this in your deck in place of an invocation you own. Mark the box next to the dragon's name this invokes. When this card is played or put into your graveyard, swap it for the invocation card.

embody_greatness.text_zh:
希亚娜专精
说出一位在世传奇英雄的名字。直到你的下一个回合开始，你成为该英雄，但你的基础生命不变。
embody_greatness.text_en:
Shiyana Specialization
Name a living legend hero. Become that hero until the start of your next turn, except your base {h} doesn't change.

ez_sqeez_bookie_syndicate.text_zh: 直到回合结束，每当你攻击英雄时，与该英雄下注。胜者创造2个金币衍生物。
ez_sqeez_bookie_syndicate.text_en: Until end of turn, whenever you attack a hero, wager with them. The winner creates 2 Gold tokens.

fight_night_prize_purse.text_zh: 选择一位对手。你与该对手各创造一个金币衍生物。
fight_night_prize_purse.text_en: Choose an opponent. You each create a Gold token.

gavel_of_natural_order.text_zh:
与副手配对
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：攻击
每当对手每回合使用或启动其第一张牌或异能时，若非其回合，在此牌上放置一个+1力量指示物。在你的结束阶段开始时，从此牌上移除所有+1力量指示物。
gavel_of_natural_order.text_en:
Pairs with an off-hand
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Attack
Whenever an opponent plays or activates their first card or ability each turn, if it's not their turn, put a +1{p} counter on this. At the beginning of your end phase, remove all +1{p} counters from this.

hit_the_jackpot.text_zh:
创造一个金币衍生物。
抽与你控制的金币总数等量的牌。
hit_the_jackpot.text_en:
Create a Gold token.
Draw cards equal to the total Gold you control.

intellect_penalty.text_zh:
你的英雄获得-1智力。
若你将创造一个带有X个指示物的智力惩罚，改为在此牌上增加X个回合指示物。
若你将在回合结束时抽牌至英雄智力值，改为抽等量的牌，从此牌上移除一个回合指示物。若此牌上没有回合指示物，将其移出游戏。
intellect_penalty.text_en:
Your hero has -1{i}.
If you would create an Intellect Penalty with X counters on it, instead add X turn counters onto this.
If you would draw up to your hero's intellect as an end-of-turn procedure, instead draw that many cards, remove a turn counter from this, and remove it from the game if it has no turn counters on it.

ire_of_the_crowd.text_zh: 在你的结束阶段开始时，若本回合你没有命中英雄，失去2点生命。
ire_of_the_crowd.text_en: At the beginning of your end phase, if you didn't hit a hero this turn, lose 2{h}.

let_me_buy_you_a_drink.name_en: Let Me Buy You a Drink
let_me_buy_you_a_drink.text_zh:
摧毁你控制的一个金币。
选择一位对手。该英雄抽一张牌。直到你的下一个回合开始，该英雄控制的以你为目标的攻击获得-2力量。
let_me_buy_you_a_drink.text_en:
Destroy a Gold you control.
Choose an opponent. They draw a card. Until the start of your next turn, attacks they control that target you get -2{p}.

marked.text_zh: 你处于被标记状态，直到一位对手命中你。
marked.text_en: You are marked until an opponent hits you.

omens_of_arcana.type_en: Omens of the Third Age Macro
omens_of_arcana.text_zh:
每位英雄以闪电流转衍生物开始游戏。
闪电流转衍生物获得法力虚空1。
omens_of_arcana.text_en:
Each hero starts the game with a Lightning Flow token.
Lightning Flow tokens get spellvoid 1.

pick_yourself_up_off_the_floor.name_en: Pick Yourself Up Off the Floor
pick_yourself_up_off_the_floor.text_zh: 将你坟场中的一张攻击行动牌置于你的牌库顶。若你的生命低于一位对手，改为将其置入你的手牌。
pick_yourself_up_off_the_floor.text_en: Put an attack action card from your graveyard on the top of your deck. If you have less {h} than an opponent, instead put it in your hand.

polly_cranka.text_zh:
行动——横置此牌，放逐此牌：将此牌在其拥有者的控制下移回竞技场，以未装备、已横置并带有一个蒸汽指示物的状态。
上弦
栖息
polly_cranka.text_en:
Action - {t}, banish this: Return this to the arena under its owner's control, unequipped, tapped, and with a steam counter.
Crank
Perched

rally_the_underdog.text_zh: 抽一张牌。若你的生命低于一位对手，改为抽2张牌。
rally_the_underdog.text_en: Draw a card. If you have less {h} than an opponent, instead draw 2 cards.

random_events_unfold.text_zh: 洗事件牌库，将此牌置于牌库底，然后翻开最顶上一张。
random_events_unfold.text_en: Shuffle the event deck, put this on the bottom, then flip the top card.

sanctuary_of_aria.text_zh: 瞬间——支付2点资源：防止本回合接下来将由你选择的一个来源对你造成的1点伤害。在结束阶段开始时摧毁此牌。
sanctuary_of_aria.text_en: Instant - {r}{r}: Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to you this turn by a source of your choice. Destroy this at the beginning of the end phase.

sticky_fingers.text_zh:
行动——横置此牌：攻击。若此牌已装备，卸下它。
当此牌攻击英雄时，偷取其控制的一个金币衍生物。
栖息
sticky_fingers.text_en:
Action - {t}: Attack. If this is equipped, unequip it.
When this attacks a hero, steal a Gold token they control.
Perched

the_hand_that_pulls_the_strings.name_en: The Hand that Pulls the Strings
the_hand_that_pulls_the_strings.text_zh:
每回合一次攻击反应——费用0：将此牌翻为正面朝上。仅当此牌在你军械库中牌面朝下时才能启动此异能。
当此牌正面朝上在军械库中时，你每回合第一次具有契约的攻击获得再动。若它正在攻击皇族英雄，它获得+1力量。
在你的结束阶段开始时，摧毁你控制的一个银币。若你没有，将此牌置于你的牌库底并抽一张牌。
the_hand_that_pulls_the_strings.text_en:
Once per Turn Attack Reaction - 0: Turn this face-up. Activate this only while this is face-down in your arsenal.
While this is face-up in arsenal, your first attack with contract each turn gets go again. If it's attacking a Royal hero, it gets +1{p}.
At the beginning of your end phase, destroy a Silver you control. If you don't, put this on the bottom of your deck and draw a card.

the_moat_exchange.text_zh: 每位英雄可以将其手牌或军械库中的任意数量牌置于其牌库底，然后为此方式置于牌库底的每张牌抽一张牌。
the_moat_exchange.text_en: Each hero may put any number of cards from their hand or arsenal on the bottom of their deck, then they draw a card for each card they put on the bottom this way.

treasure_island.text_zh:
每回合第一次英雄被攻击时，在此牌上放置一个金币指示物。
每当你或你控制的盟友对对手英雄造成伤害时，你从此牌上移除等量的金币指示物，然后创造与此方式移除的指示物数量相等的金币衍生物。
treasure_island.text_en:
The first time a hero is attacked each turn, put a gold counter on this.
Whenever you or an ally you control deals damage to an opposing hero, you remove that many gold counters from this, then create Gold tokens equal to the number of counters removed this way.

tremor_of_anticipation.text_zh:
直到回合结束，若任意英雄将创造1个或更多衍生物，改为其创造数量加1的每种这些衍生物。
创造一个金币衍生物。
tremor_of_anticipation.text_en:
Until end of turn, if any hero would create 1 or more tokens, instead they create that many plus 1 of each of those tokens.
Create a Gold token.

visit_the_winner_takes_all.text_zh: 直到回合结束，你的攻击获得"当此牌攻击英雄时，你与该英雄各创造一个金币衍生物，然后你与该英雄下注。胜者获得另一位英雄控制的所有金币衍生物的控制权。"
visit_the_winner_takes_all.text_en: Until end of turn, your attacks get "When this attacks a hero, you each create a Gold token, then you wager with them. The winner gains control of all Gold tokens the other hero controls."
